method.source_baseline: Read the complete frozen CNXML and metadata. Parse all exercise elements in canonical order; no ID is inferred from visual numbering.
method.sets: Parse actual MathML numerator/denominator or decimal as exact rational values. Counting starts1; whole starts0. Accept the same member set in any order.
method.place: Locate each requested digit in the actual numeral; uniqueness checked. Record place name and separate digit-times-place contribution.
method.names: Generate international coefficient-and-scale English reference independently from the numeral; parse actual source English number phrases back to an integer. This is numerical checking, not a Telugu wording prescription.
method.rounding: For nonnegative integer n and requested power-of-ten p: q,r=divmod(n,p); result=(q+(2*r>=p))*p. Check distances to q*p and (q+1)*p, and adjacent controlling digit; no floating point or Python round.
method.provided: Compare every supplied numerical solution to the independent result; free-writing sample to a rubric. Hyphens/capitalization alone do not change numerical value.
method.scope: The finite exercises are recomputed, not the external historical population, mountain, astronomy, budget or water-capacity data.
